secrets.name: VITE_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Project URL of the user's own Supabase project (https://<ref>.supabase.co). Must be the bare URL only — no surrounding prose, quotes or backticks, or the browser client cannot be constructed.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Same Project URL as VITE_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL; consumed by server-side Supabase operations.

secrets.name: VITE_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Publishable (sb_publishable_… or legacy anon) key of that same Supabase project. Used by the browser client and by the server-side auth middleware when it verifies session tokens; it must belong to the same project as the URL above.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key for admin/server-side operations (deposit settlement, push notifications, email). Obtain from Supabase dashboard → Settings → API → service_role key.

secrets.name: KORAPAY_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Korapay secret API key for payment processing. Obtain from Korapay dashboard.

secrets.name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: VAPID public key for web push notifications. Generate with web-push tools.

secrets.name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: VAPID private key for web push notifications. Generate with web-push tools.

secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: AI gateway API key for deposit receipt verification. Obtain from your AI provider.
